description: A broadcast director must approve the final livestream plan for a film festival charity gala, including geographic access, replay availability, the podium audio setup, and required production follow-up actions.

shared_context.S1: The festival charity gala is scheduled for a live online broadcast on Saturday evening.
shared_context.S2: The draft distribution plan would stream the program worldwide, keep a replay available for seven days, and use a wireless microphone at the podium.
shared_context.S3: Morgan has final authority to approve the broadcast plan and its production instructions.
shared_context.S4: The festival's standard final sign-off includes a verbal check with engineering and clearance before the broadcast plan is approved.

PF1.text: Jules found during this morning's final radio-frequency scan that the wireless podium microphone intermittently overlaps the venue's emergency-communications channel; the podium must use the tested wired microphone instead. Jules recorded the scan in the engineering worksheet, but the worksheet has not yet been circulated to the production team.

PF2.text: Rina confirmed with Northstar Archives this afternoon that the gala's licensed archival clip may be streamed live only to viewers in the United States, may not remain available as a replay, and requires the on-screen credit exactly 'Courtesy of Northstar Archives'. Rina has the licensor's email in the clearance inbox but has not copied it into the broadcast plan.

acceptance_conditions: The livestream must be restricted to the United States.
The seven-day replay must be disabled.
The podium must use the tested wired microphone.
The archival clip must receive the exact required on-screen credit.
An engineering follow-up commitment addressing the podium microphone change or RF scan must be recorded.
A clearance or plan-revision commitment addressing the archival license restrictions must be recorded.

content_checks.C1: decisions['stream_territory'] in ['United States only', 'US only', 'U.S. only']
content_checks.C3: decisions['podium_microphone'] in ['wired', 'tested wired microphone', 'tested wired mic']
content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] in ['Jules', 'engineering worksheet', 'podium_audio'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] in ['Rina', 'clearance inbox', 'broadcast plan', 'production team'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts

decisive_facts.why: The RF scan changes the podium microphone from the draft wireless setup to a tested wired microphone and requires an engineering follow-up concerning Jules, the engineering worksheet, or podium audio.

The Northstar Archives license changes the territory to United States only, disables replay, fixes the credit to 'Courtesy of Northstar Archives', and requires a clearance or broadcast-plan follow-up.
